mutations.name: the tests member of a non-source head gets no question
kills: shape briefs asks the tests member of a head proceeding as no-repro-non-source the question for what it changes

mutations.name: the adversary gets no fix-round focus
kills: the adversary brief on a fix round adds a focus on the open findings and the changed ranges since the reviewed head

mutations.name: the focus skips the scope checks
kills: the adversary brief on a fix round adds no focus for a scope the brief's checks refuse

mutations.name: the adversary's base brief takes the scope
kills: the adversary brief on a fix round keeps the full-diff instruction and carries no unchanged-line rule
